# Actian Design System

> Actian's design system, packaged as a Claude Code plugin. 4 skills: answers from the knowledge, a proposal with its intent.md, a clickable prototype pushed to Figma on request, and an audit of a Figma frame with its specs.md, through the claude.ai Figma connector. 463 tokens (3 themes), 333 DS Kit components, 287 FM Kit wireframe components, 28 Meta Kit components.

The Actian DS is in a federated configuration (2026-05-09): the **knowledge layer** lives in [`volivarii/actian-ds-knowledge`](https://github.com/volivarii/actian-ds-knowledge); this plugin vendors a pinned snapshot, refreshed nightly. The URLs below point AI agents at the canonical knowledge repo. The plugin's own AI orientation, skill cards and Figma notes are linked at the bottom under "Plugin meta-docs".

## Docs

- [AI agent orientation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/Actian-DS-Claude-plugin/main/plugins/actian-design-system/docs/llms-overview.md): start here — explains how DS knowledge is organized across tokens, registries, guidelines, and skills
- [Plugin README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/Actian-DS-Claude-plugin/main/README.md): repo-level overview
- [Plugin usage guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/Actian-DS-Claude-plugin/main/USAGE.md): how to invoke the 4 skills

## Knowledge — Foundations

- [Foundations canonical doc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/actian-ds-knowledge/main/foundations/dist/foundations.md): MD-as-SoT for spacing, typography, color, motion
- [Foundations authoring guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/actian-ds-knowledge/main/foundations/src/AUTHORING.md): how to update foundations
- [Tokens (DTCG JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/actian-ds-knowledge/main/tokens/tokens.json): 463 tokens, 3 themes
- [Tokens (CSS)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/actian-ds-knowledge/main/tokens/tokens.css): CSS custom property form

## Knowledge — Content & Accessibility

- [Content guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/actian-ds-knowledge/main/content/dist/global.md): voice, tone, copy patterns
- [Accessibility guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/actian-ds-knowledge/main/accessibility/dist/accessibility.bundle.json): WCAG 2.2 AA conformance

## Knowledge — Components

- [DS Kit registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/actian-ds-knowledge/main/components/dist/registries/dskit.json): 333 design system components with keys, variants, and properties
- [FM Kit registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/actian-ds-knowledge/main/components/dist/registries/fmkit.json): 287 wireframe components
- [Meta Kit registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/actian-ds-knowledge/main/components/dist/registries/metakit.json): 28 components
- [App context](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/actian-ds-knowledge/main/app-context/dist/app-context.json): apps, entities, terminology, patterns
- [FM↔DS map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/Actian-DS-Claude-plugin/main/plugins/actian-design-system/references/actian-ux-prototype/fm-to-ds-map.json): wireframe-to-DS component mapping (kept in the plugin)

## Plugin meta-docs (skill cards + Figma notes)

- [/actian-ux card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/Actian-DS-Claude-plugin/main/plugins/actian-design-system/skills/actian-ux/SKILL.md): answers from the knowledge, the rules every task follows, which skill fits
- [/actian-ux-proposal card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/Actian-DS-Claude-plugin/main/plugins/actian-design-system/skills/actian-ux-proposal/SKILL.md): the proposal document and intent.md, from one proposal data file
- [/actian-ux-prototype card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/Actian-DS-Claude-plugin/main/plugins/actian-design-system/skills/actian-ux-prototype/SKILL.md): the clickable prototype, the Figma push and the specs.md seed
- [Prototype files](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/Actian-DS-Claude-plugin/main/plugins/actian-design-system/skills/actian-ux-prototype/prototype-files.md): the screen list, the brief, the four author files and every check-direct finding with its fix
- [Figma screen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/Actian-DS-Claude-plugin/main/plugins/actian-design-system/skills/actian-ux-prototype/figma-screen.md): the screen JSON the Figma push takes
- [/actian-ux-audit card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/Actian-DS-Claude-plugin/main/plugins/actian-design-system/skills/actian-ux-audit/SKILL.md): findings with evidence and fixes, and specs.md from the final frame
- [Figma API traps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volivarii/Actian-DS-Claude-plugin/main/plugins/actian-design-system/skills/actian-ux-audit/figma-api-traps.md): catalogue of methods that throw, properties not bindable, silently-fail patterns
